title: chezmoi host data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/hosts.yaml. Validates structure only -- it cannot catch a quadlet missing from `units`, a wrong port, or a typo'd IP. Syncthing folders live in .chezmoidata/syncthing.yaml, validated by syncthing.schema.json.

domain.description: Base domain. Every endpoint is served as <name>.<domain>, and every host with an `ip` resolves as <hostname>.<domain>.

hosts.description: The only place hosts are named. A host absent here fails every template with `map has no entry for key "<hostname>"`.

propertyNames.description: Must match the machine's HostName exactly.

roles.description: What the box is for. Required: .chezmoiignore reads it unguarded, so omitting it errors under missingkey=error.

oneOf.description: Deploys the rootless podman quadlets listed in `quadlets`.
Used for games. Combined with `server`, also installs gaming-mode.
minecraft@ units, the backup timer, and the helper scripts.
Sunshine game-stream host: installs the package and enables the user unit it ships. Kept out of `units` on purpose so gaming-mode never stops it.
Moonlight client — streams from a `sunshine` host. Linux only; on macOS the cask is in the Brewfile, which is not role-gated.
Shared EmuDeck library: installs syncthing, enables its user unit, and renders the folders in `syncthing.folders`. Also needs `syncthing_id` once the host has run syncthing once.
Owns Caddy, CoreDNS, cloudflared and the /etc deploy. Move it to relocate the whole edge.

user.description: Login account on that machine. Only consumer is ~/.ssh/config: a host without it gets no Host block, so it cannot be reached by short name.

ip.description: Optional. Present means the host gets <hostname>.<domain> in both DNS views, and its endpoints resolve to these addresses.

quadlets.description: Podman quadlet filename PREFIXES, matched as <prefix>* — so `immich` picks up immich.pod and the whole immich/ subdir. Only deploys where the host also has the `podman` role.

items.description: A prefix, not a filename — leave the extension off.

units.description: Systemd user units gaming-mode suspends and restores. Name EVERY unit, not just a pod: Requires= propagates stop to dependents but start only to dependencies, so starting immich-pod alone brings up an empty pod.

items.description: Without the .service suffix — the template appends it. minecraft@<instance> entries also generate the Conflicts= line in minecraft@.service.

endpoints.description: Hostnames to serve and resolve. Generates the Caddy blocks, both CoreDNS views, and the Cloudflare Tunnel ingress rules.

syncthing_id.description: This host's Syncthing device ID, from `syncthing --device-id`. Derived from a TLS cert generated on first run, so it cannot be known before the host has applied once -- empty string means config.xml omits folders and devices rather than half-rendering them. Public data (a hash of the cert public key), safe to commit.

lan.description: Resolved for LAN clients (the 192.168.15.0/24 CoreDNS view).

tailscale.description: Resolved for tailnet clients (the 100.64.0.0/10 CoreDNS view).

name.description: Label only — <name>.<domain> is the full hostname, so leave the domain off. Need not match the quadlet: calibre-web-automated is served as `books`.

port.description: Upstream port. OMIT for a DNS record with no reverse-proxy block and no tunnel rule — that is how minecraft is reached over its own TCP port.

public.description: true adds a Cloudflare Tunnel ingress rule, reachable from the public internet. Still needs `cloudflared tunnel route dns` once to create the CNAME.

scheme.description: The UPSTREAM's scheme, not the listener's. Caddy always terminates TLS itself; set https only when the thing behind it also speaks TLS.

oneOf.description: Upstream speaks TLS — usually wants tls_insecure too.

tls_insecure.description: Skip verification of the upstream's certificate. Only meaningful with scheme: https, e.g. CoreDNS's self-signed DoH listener.

log.description: false disables the JSON access log at /var/log/caddy/<name>-access.log.
